archive_safety.approach: Deterministic gzip/tar creation with fixed metadata; checksum verification before extraction; rejection of absolute, drive-qualified, traversal, backslash-traversal, duplicate, prefix-collision, link, device and other non-file/non-directory members; exact repository/receipt roots; empty destination requirement; post-extraction containment verification; standalone real .git directory requirement.
archive_safety.candidate_displacement: Validation only accepts an empty destination and never promotes, overwrites, resets, cleans, or displaces an existing snapshot.

external_side_effects.statement: Production helper code performs no GitHub or ChatGPT Library calls, no network I/O, and no fetch, push, lock acquisition/deletion, merge, branch retirement, or Library deletion. Git subprocesses are limited to local fsck, status, rev-parse, and symbolic-ref inspection with prompts, optional locks, fsmonitor, and hooks disabled.
